def solve():
    n = 25
    tier1_n = min(n, 25)
    tier2_n = max(n - 25, 0)
    gross = tier1_n * Q(1200) + tier2_n * Q(2600)
    closed = 1
    uncapped = Q(500) * closed
    cap = gross * Q(20) / 100
    if gross >= 45000:
        applied = min(uncapped, cap)
    else:
        applied = Q(0)
    net = gross - applied
    return {
        "final": net,
        "gross_cost": gross,
        "uncapped_credit": uncapped,
        "applied_credit": applied,
    }
